description: This PHP script automates recruitment data setup for the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to truncate relevant tables, insert predefined job titles and vacancies, generate synthetic candidate data with associated CVs, vacancy applications, and history records, and manages database transactions. The script references external configuration and description files to populate data dynamically.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: External configuration class providing database connection details.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Truncates key recruitment-related tables to reset data state.

methods.name: addJobTitles
methods.description: Inserts predefined job titles into the database and updates sequence ID.

methods.name: addJobVacancies
methods.description: Creates job vacancy records with descriptions and updates sequence ID.

methods.name: addCandidates
methods.description: Generates multiple candidate records along with related vacancy applications and history details.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Placeholder function for debugging or logging; currently commented out.

methods.name: checkQueryResult
methods.description: Checks database query results, rolls back on error, and outputs errors.

methods.name: getCandidateQPartial
methods.description: Builds a partial SQL VALUES string for inserting candidate data.

methods.name: getCvQPartial
methods.description: Creates a partial SQL string for inserting candidate CVs.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyQPartial
methods.description: Builds SQL partial for candidate-vacancy link records.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryQPartial
methods.description: Creates SQL partial for candidate history entries.
